landing.seoDescription: Jessie's personal blog. I work in AI development in Shanghai and write about work, my Australian working holiday, travel, and everyday life.

headline: Hi, I'm Jessie.
paragraphs: I work in AI development in Shanghai. Before coming back to China, I spent a year on a working holiday in Australia.
I write here about problems I run into doing AI development, my year in Australia, trips I’ve taken, and life back in China.
